samples.summary: The header/footer slim toolbar's B/I/U toggles were changed the same way but have no test at all
samples.evidence: The diff duplicates the fix (not reusing TextFormatGroup) in the `isHeaderFooter` branch of docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx (lines 391–406). The new test file only mounts `TextFormatGroup` (packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/text-format-toggles.test.ts:99), and grepping the frontend test tree for `DocsFormattingToolbar` / `isHeaderFooter` returns zero test files (only src files: shared-document.tsx, harness/hunt/page.tsx, docs-detail.tsx, App.tsx, docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx). So this second, hand-copied copy of the toggle logic could regress (e.g. reverting to `getSelectionStyle()`, or dropping `isStyleOn` so `'mixed'` becomes truthy) with the suite still green. Note also that these slim toggles pass no `pressed` prop, so no test could even observe their state.

samples.summary: The bug being fixed (backward selection) is only ever asserted by a mock that hardcodes the desired answer; nothing tests that getRangeStyleSummary is actually correct for a backward selection
samples.evidence: `makeEditor` stubs `getRangeStyleSummary: vi.fn(() => summary)` with the value the test wants (line 41), so the tests prove only "the component reads the summary and applies !isStyleOn" — the entire premise of the fix (that a backward/right-to-left selection makes `getSelectionStyle()` report the preceding run while `getRangeStyleSummary()` reports the range correctly) is asserted nowhere. In packages/docs/test/view/editor-range-style-summary.test.ts every `_setSelectionForTest` call uses a forward range (anchor offset <= focus offset: lines 101-104, 124-127, 144-147, 167-170, 197-200, 292-295, 314-317, 340-343) or a collapsed caret; there is no anchor>focus case and no `bold` backward case. So the issue #715 repro (bold `abcdef`, backward-select `cd`, un-bold, re-bold) is not covered end-to-end by any test, and if the summary happened to be caret-based/incorrect for backward ranges the new tests would still pass.
searchedFor: Grep backward|reverse|anchor in that test file

samples.summary: isStyleOn's `undefined` branch (style unset throughout the range) is untested
samples.evidence: `isStyleOn(value: boolean | 'mixed' | undefined)` documents three inputs; the new tests only feed `true`, `false` and `'mixed'` (CASES loop, text-format-toggles.test.ts:98/107/116). `getRangeStyleSummary()` explicitly returns `undefined` when a key is unset throughout (types.ts:26-29, and packages/docs/test/view/editor-range-style-summary.test.ts:134 'returns undefined when the key is unset throughout'), which is the common case for plain text, so the most frequent toggle path has no assertion and no direct unit test of the helper exists.

finding.summary: The header/footer slim toolbar's B/I/U toggles were changed the same way but have no test at all
finding.evidence: The diff duplicates the fix (not reusing TextFormatGroup) in the `isHeaderFooter` branch of docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx (lines 391–406). The new test file only mounts `TextFormatGroup` (packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/text-format-toggles.test.ts:99), and grepping the frontend test tree for `DocsFormattingToolbar` / `isHeaderFooter` returns zero test files (only src files: shared-document.tsx, harness/hunt/page.tsx, docs-detail.tsx, App.tsx, docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx). So this second, hand-copied copy of the toggle logic could regress (e.g. reverting to `getSelectionStyle()`, or dropping `isStyleOn` so `'mixed'` becomes truthy) with the suite still green. verdict.reason: The header/footer slim toolbar carries its own copy of the range-aware toggle logic (docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:391-406, using getRangeStyleSummary + isStyleOn), and nothing in the repository tests it. A repo-wide grep for `DocsFormattingToolbar|docs-formatting-toolbar` matches only source files (docs-detail.tsx:28,214; harness/hunt/page.tsx:38,315; shared-document.tsx; App.tsx), documentation, and .agent-review artifacts — no test file imports the component, and there is no barrel index in src/app/docs that could hide an indirect import. The new test only mounts TextFormatGroup (text-format-toggles.test.ts:99,108,117). I also checked the non-obvious places: colocated tests under packages/frontend/src (**/*.test.ts(x) and **/__tests__/**), the absence of any e2e directory, packages/docs/test (which covers header editContext at the model/view layer only, not the React toolbar), and the hunt harness route, which mounts the toolbar with the default editContext='body' and is a manual probe with no assertions. So the duplicated toggles could regress to getSelectionStyle() or drop isStyleOn with the suite still green; the toggles also pass no `pressed` prop (lines 449, 458, 467), confirming their state is unobservable.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. In packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/text-format-toggles.test.ts, makeEditor (lines 34-52) stubs getRangeStyleSummary: vi.fn(() => summary) and every case (95-155) injects the desired summary, so the tests only prove the component applies !isStyleOn(summary) — the backward-selection premise is hardcoded. I enumerated every real-implementation caller in tests via grep of getRangeStyleSummary across packages/**/*.test.ts: docs/test/view/editor-range-style-summary.test.ts (all 12 selections forward or collapsed: 101-104, 124-127, 144-147, 167-170, 197-200, 218-221, 243-246, 262-265, 292-295, 314-317, 340-343, 361-364), editor-read-only.test.ts:261,272 (forward 0->5), docs/test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts:812,815 (collapsed caret), editor-step-selection-font-size.test.ts:236 (caret pending); all slides/frontend others are () => ({}) stubs. I additionally grepped 'backward|reverse|right-to-left' across all package test files (only unrelated deleteBackward/sendBackward/caret-affinity hits), multiline-grepped for anchor.offset > focus.offset in test files (no matches), checked pointer-drag selection tests in packages/docs/test (only image-selection-overlay.test.ts), checked .spec.ts files (backend only) and looked for e2e/playwright suites (none exist). The direction-normalizing code the fix relies on (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2897-2900, plus 2927-2929 and 2943) is therefore never driven with a reversed range, and the todo's claimed regression test (docs/tasks/active/20260810-docs-range-aware-toggles-todo.md:46-47) is satisfied only by the mock. No counterexample found; the missing-coverage claim holds and is in the test-adequacy lane (claimed coverage of the fixed bug is fake).
